name: memorization_four_head_adamw_ten_seeds_v7
notes: Ten-seed AdamW replication of the four-head memorization experiment. Same architecture, fixed data split, 25% random-label corruption, canaries, and seed list as the Muon+QK-Clip replication. AdamW uses the pinned source profile without tuning: lr 6e-4, min lr 6e-5, betas 0.9/0.95, weight decay 0.10, one-equivalent-epoch warmup-cosine schedule. 30k updates with behavior and checkpoints every 500 updates. WeightWatcher is post-hoc so spectral measurement cannot perturb training.
